comment: The deformation battery: the poses a rig is reviewed in, not poses anybody would ship. Same format and the same convention as templates/poses/*.json -- local joint rotations, XYZW, the order the pose editor saves -- because they go through the same sheet pipeline and the same op_sheet renderer. Chosen to put every joint through the range where a bad weight map shows: hips and knees folded, shoulders at their limit, elbows and knees at a right angle, and the spine twisted about its own axis. Symmetric rows carry L and R as exact mirrors (x, -y, -z, w), which is what rigging.mirror_quaternion means and what the tests check.
